location.description: Approximate anomaly location in the image, or unknown if evidence is insufficient.

color.description: Salient visible color or appearance cue, or unknown if evidence is insufficient.

shape.description: Visible geometric or morphological description, or unknown if evidence is insufficient.

area_size.description: Relative or physical size of the anomalous region, or unknown if evidence is insufficient.

quantity.description: Number of anomaly instances when visible, or unknown if evidence is insufficient.

reason.description: Visible or strongly supported cause; use unknown when the cause is not visually supported.
